research_scope: Four exact Jurong Point public-access branches with zero existing menu rows. Public Foodpanda outlet menu pages were used for factual menu names and displayed delivery prices. No API calls, Mapbox calls, paid services or spending.

dedupe_and_integration_notes: All four target SFA licences have zero Menu Items rows in the baseline workbook. Each proposed item name is unique within its exact SFA licence in this proposal; duplicate variants were avoided or explicitly disambiguated by the listing name.
Branch joins verified against the exact Public F&B Directory address, unit, mall and postal code and the outlet page footer. Use SFA licence as the stable join key.
The Foodpanda listing prices are delivery prices. Do not present them as in-store prices; retain published promo/list-price pairs where shown.
Refresh132 parent integrator should recheck each outlet menu page at integration time because delivery listings, menu availability, discounts, and seasonal items can change quickly.
No workbook or Excel file was changed; this JSON is a read-only proposal.

limitations: Foodpanda page retrieval/search result indicates crawl markers ranging from yesterday to two months ago; although the rendered pages expose prices/items at research time, exact freshness is uncertain, especially on older-crawl pages.
Delivery catalogues and their prices may differ from in-store menus and vary by address, promotion, and time.
Several menus contain named limited-time/campaign categories; those items may no longer be available by the next refresh.
No reusable image URLs were proposed in this delivery-menu task because image rights/reuse were not verified.
The workbook has 38,273 directory rows; this review covers only four branches with zero menu rows and does not establish nationwide menu completeness.
